entries.key: what was the revenue by channel in 2025

response.answer: In 2025, counting only paid orders, the website brought in R$ 944,397.08, the app R$ 391,837.18 and the marketplace R$ 146,140.00. The website leads with more than twice the app's revenue.

entries.key: what were the top 5 products by quantity sold in the second half of 2025

response.answer: In the second half of 2025, the 5 products with the most units sold in paid orders were Starry Savanna Whole Bean 1 kg (926), Moonlight Peak Whole Bean 250 g (885), Misty Valley Whole Bean 250 g (878), Gentle Creek Fermented Whole Bean 250 g (742) and Misty Valley Whole Bean 1 kg (720). All five are whole-bean coffees.

entries.key: how did website revenue change month by month in 2025

response.answer: In 2025, the website's monthly revenue from paid orders went from R$ 48,418.38 in January, the lowest of the year, to R$ 120,125.16 in November, the highest. October closed at R$ 99,661.07 and December at R$ 107,821.45.

entries.key: what was the average order value of paid orders in each channel

response.answer: For paid orders, the average order value was R$ 487.56 on the website, R$ 365.52 in the app and R$ 247.28 on the marketplace. The website has the highest average order among the three channels.

entries.key: what is the revenue by product category in 2025
